messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: ap-south1-rack2: node-gpu-17 reported 12 XID errors and 3 unexpected reboots in the last 20m. Investigate.
ada: seeing a bump in 95p tail latency for inference-serving there, started ~10:05UTC. correlates with infra-bot alert.
mike: grabbing logs now, could be thermal + power spikes. quick nvml: `nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,POWER -i 0` shows power limit toggling between 250W and 150W intermittently.
sato: we rolled PSU fw v2.1.4 to that rack last night as part of the maintenance batch. could be related.
ada: interesting — thermal sensors on that card also show transient +25C jumps then drop. not normal.
mike: paste of recent `kern.log` tail: ```Jan 12 10:06:11 node-gpu-17 kernel: NVRM: Xid (0x4e) at GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.```

julia: Xid 0x4e usually means GPU reset due to fatal error (often power/thermal). we had a few flaky cards last year with similar pattern.
ada: impact: autoscaler kept routing requests -> microbursts of timeouts while processes restarted. rolling 5% QPS spike in latency.
oncall: can we drain the node to avoid client impact? i can schedule a quick drain and reprovision.
mike: yes, drain recommended. run: `rctl node drain node-gpu-17 --reason "XID+power" --force` then move active jobs: `kubectl drain node-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
sato: hold — before full drain, can we collect `nvml` traces and `ipmitool sdr`? might show PSU rail flapping. commands: `nvidia-smi dmon -s u -o D` and `ipmitool sdr elist`
ada: running those now, attaching snippets. `nvidia-smi dmon` shows PWR at times 135W -> 260W -> back to 130W within 10s windows.
mike: IPMI shows 12V rail voltage dipping to 11.2V during those bursts. that's under spec.
julia: low 12V + PSU fw change = likely firmware bug or marginal PSU unit. recommend isolating the PSU, do not reboot the whole node until we have spare capacity.
oncall: scheduling drain in 5m to protect frontends. will route traffic to other racks and spin up cold replicas.
ada: also enabling fallback routing: `routing-policy set ap-south1 prefer: rack1,rack3` for 30m to reduce load on rack2.
sato: tagging hardware: node-gpu-17 -> `hw:psu-suspect`, and creating case with vendor. include `ipmitool sel elist` + nvml traces.
mike: quick mitigation: set power cap to conservative 180W on that GPU: `nvidia-smi -i 0 -pl 180` to stop the rapid swings until we replace the PSU. reduces perf by ~10% but stops resets.
julia: agree, set cap and monitor. also set alert for >3 XIDs in 1h for that rack.
oncall: maintenance window requested for 02:00 UTC to swap PSU and run soak tests. owners: @sato and @mike on hardware, @ada to validate perf after replace.
ada: please note customer-facing impact: estimated QPS reduction ~6% during swap if we can't absorb with existing spare capacity. cost impact: extra on-demand GPUs ~2 hours -> ~ $120/hr estimated. cc @finance if needed.
sato: opening vendor ticket: TICKET-AP-8723, vendor response ETA 24h. attaching logs and ipmi dumps.
mike: for immediate triage, I've added a kdump-trigger to capture kernel oops if a reset happens: `echo c > /proc/sysrq-trigger` (only if we see a hang) and enabled persistent NVML logging.
julia: long-term: revert PSU fw on remaining racks until vendor confirms fix. schedule farm-wide canary for fw updates.
oncall: drain started at 10:15UTC. status: `kubectl get nodes | grep node-gpu-17` -> `SchedulingDisabled` and pods evicted.
ad a: running inference smoke now against replicas in rack1, tail latency back to baseline. will keep monitoring for 30m.
mike: still seeing occasional XID in archived logs but no new reboots after power-cap set.
sato: created board label and ordered replacement PSU unit to be delivered to datacenter tomorrow.
julia: after swap, we'll run stress test: `stress-ng --gpu 0 --timeout 30m` plus nvml monitoring to verify stable rails.
ada: thanks all. will update thread after soak. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: NOTE: auto-rotation of routing policy will revert at 10:50UTC unless extended.
oncall: extended routing policy to 11:30UTC.
mike: post-mortem note for ops: add a metric for rapid PWR swings >50W in 10s window — that would have bubbled up earlier.
sato: vendor ticket updated with IPMI dumps and dmon csvs.
ad a: soak complete at 10:58UTC, no further XIDs, tail latency steady. marking as mitigated, PSU swap still scheduled for overnight replacement and verification.
julia: add follow-up action: evaluate fw rollback plan and inventory of PSUs by fw version.
oncall: closing incident for now. if anything else pops up, reopen thread. :bow:
